_comment: Docs pricing snapshot for Report 014, fetched 2026-10-07T20:16Z (8 Oct 2026, 04:16 SGT) by the operator's session from the pricing page's markdown form, as Report 013. DECLARED: read from vendor documentation, not measured. The page file is kept on disk beside this snapshot and is not published: it carries the vendor's contact addresses, which lib/hygiene.js flags; the snapshot records its sha256. Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length; a Driftproof call's prompt is far below 100,000 tokens, so the first Haiku 5.5 row is the one the registry takes.
